programme.desc: S4E8 - Wardens investigate the story of a veterinarian who claims he killed a bear out of season but in self-defense; the waterfowl season opener brings out the hunters in full force and a warden goes undercover to find illegal activity. (Reality, Crime, Outdoors, Animals)

programme.title: Amanda to the Rescue - Floppy-Footed Pit Bull
programme.desc: S2E1 - New rescues include a 9-month-old pit bull with a fractured jaw and a 4-month-old Dalmatian with an eye condition that could lead to blindness. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Amanda to the Rescue - Professor Clovis and the Hamburglar
programme.desc: S2E2 - The rescue receives two new residents: Professor Clovis, a miniature schnauzer with a suspected liver shunt who needs a complicated and costly surgery, and Hamburglar, a blind puppy who Amanda prepares for his new forever family. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees - Judgement Day
programme.desc: S3E1 - Tia's dream of relocating becomes a nightmare as fate turns against her; a call from the former owner of one of Villalobos' most aggressive dogs leads to the ranch's most emotional reunion yet. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees - Pushing the Limits
programme.desc: S3E9 - Roommates with extreme lifestyles want to adopt a pit bull; Tia rescues an abandoned mastiff. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees - Southern Uprising
programme.desc: S3E5 - Tia and the twins hit the road after she receives back-to-back calls for help from the South; after helping an army veteran with a new litter of puppies, the team find themselves on a wild chase after an injured dog through Jackson, Miss. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees - Prison Break
programme.desc: S3E2 - Tia sends Jake and Armando on a rescue mission to Texas after hearing about two pit bulls who were wounded in a run-in with a porcupine; when a second story about a dog on death row comes in, the guys need to kick it into high gear. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees - New Blood
programme.desc: S3E3 - Tia decides to hire new parolees, but one parolee may blow his chance at redemption on the first day; shocking news about one of Villalobos' most beloved dogs, Creature, threatens to end his chances of being adopted. (Reality, Animals, Pets)

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins - Oscar the Grouchy Frogmouth
programme.desc: S2E6 - Terri returns to her hometown in Oregon to help Brady, a cougar in need of a vital health check; at the zoo, Robert is on a mission to rescue Oscar, a small bird with a big attitude; Bindi bathes an echidna with bad skin allergies. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins - Bosco the Croc's Big Move
programme.desc: S2E1 - Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo; Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem; Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins - Terri's Wonder Wallaby
programme.desc: S4E3 - Terri responds to the call when Daniel, a very special wallaby, becomes severely injured and cannot walk; Robert and Chandler catch some waves before taking a road trip to pick up a new Komodo dragon; Bindi checks in on Tallbert the giraffe calf. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins - Tiny but Poisonous
programme.desc: S4E5 - Bindi welcomes the arrival of tiny poison dart frogs to their new home at the zoo; Terri takes charge when the crew moves Bosco out of the Crocoseum; Chandler helps a glider called Kronk. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins - Bad Boy Bunker
programme.desc: S4E2 - Robert handles an aggressive wombat called Bunker, and it's moving day for a giant anaconda called Nikki; Terri helps treat hundreds of lorikeets injured by a hailstorm; Later, Robert and Chandler team up to bake a special treat for the Irwin ladies. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - Alarmed & Dangerous
programme.desc: S4E8 - The four eldest Brown brothers prepare for a second solo mission with hopes of redeeming themselves; visitors arrive in Browntown. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - Bush Heart
programme.desc: S4E9 - Matt, Bam, Bear and Gabe feel the strain of making deliveries in harsh conditions; a decision that will change the lives of the wolf pack is made. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - The Wolf Pack Returns
programme.desc: S5E2 - A happy homecoming for the Brown family that costs valuable time, and the lack of a working skiff, may leave a highly risky haul as the only possible remedy. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - Driving Miss Rainy
programme.desc: S5E3 - Noah stays behind to continue repairs to Browntown; the rest of the wolf pack embark on their riskiest haul yet with the aim of securing the skiff they need. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - Winter Watch
programme.desc: S5E4 - Patriarch Billy seizes an opportunity to tie up loose ends, strengthen his ties with the bush, and keep the wolf pack close with a family visit to Excursion Inlet. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People - Growing the Wolfpack
programme.desc: S5E5 - An early spring provides an opportunity for the family of nine to address unfinished business; a visitor from Billy's distant past could undermine the future of Browntown. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: The Kitchen - Get That Dinner Done!
programme.desc: S30E10 - The hosts have shortcuts and easy recipes for flavorful weeknight meals, including a turkey Reuben, peanut sauce over shrimp skewers and rice noodles, and easy veggie marinara ravioli bake; chef Jet Tila stops by. (Cooking)

programme.title: The Kitchen - The Kitchen's Super Savers
programme.desc: S32E1 - "The Kitchen" hosts share money-saving ingredients for hearty family meals; Geoffrey Zakarian gets two meals from his slow-roasted pork shoulder, Katie Lee Biegel creates a chilaquiles frittata, and Sunny Anderson presents a potato recipe round-up. (Cooking)

programme.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Seafood Feast (New)
programme.desc: S1E1 - Chef Gabe Bertaccini shows you the heart of real Italian cooking: simple, fresh ingredients and family recipes with a whole lot of love. (Cooking)

programme.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Dinner for Two
programme.desc: S1E2 - Chef Gabe Bertaccini makes Gnocchi di Ricotta alla Sorrentina and Lasagna Bianca. The pillowy ricotta gnocchi are baked in a bright tomato sauce with melted mozzarella, and this lasagna goes all-in on creamy béchamel, layers of pasta, and melty cheese. (Cooking)

programme.title: Pitmasters - Core Four Cook-Off
programme.desc: S1E5 - In the ultimate live-fire endurance challenge, the teams face four barbecue pillars: chicken, pork ribs, pork shoulder and beef brisket. Exhaustion is taking its toll, but the teams who can dig deep have a chance to win $1,000 for each round. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Pitmasters - Backyard BBQ
programme.desc: S1E6 - The remaining four teams fight for a spot in the semifinals by preparing a classic barbecue potluck with a live-fire main course and two sides. The pitmasters only have three hours to pull it off and impress the judges enough to win a $5,000 prize. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Pitmasters - The Whole Hog
programme.desc: S1E7 - The three remaining teams transform a whole hog into a cohesive, competition-worthy meal to earn $8,000 and a spot in the finale. Plus, the judges want a different meal for lunch, and they're willing to pay for it with another $4,000 up for grabs. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From North to South America
programme.desc: S26E8 - Guy Fieri's digs into flavors spanning the Americas; in Charlotte, N.C., a brewery serves the bomb bacon jam burger and a duck confit flatbread; in Cancun, Mexico, a spot serves street tacos; in Houston, a joint cooks up Argentinian empanadas. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Breakfast, Brisket and Belly
programme.desc: S27E14 - In Los Angeles, a late-night spot serves breakfast with a twist, like drunken French toast; in Columbus, Ohio, a funky joint serves creative combos like brisket on corn cakes; in Phoenix, a barbecue stop smokes up prime rib and pork belly dumplings. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Playin' Chicken
programme.desc: S28E19 - An Alameda, Calif., joint cooks Nashville hot-style chicken and puts a gourmet twist on a burger; in Lansing, Mich., chicken is served French-style at a funky pizza-pasta place; a Kona, Hawaii, spot blends Southern comfort with island flair. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwich Showcase
programme.desc: S30E3 - Guy Fieri is on the road to grab some serious sandwiches; in Austin, a rock-n-roll brunch bar adds a funky touch to meatloaf and a Monte Cristo; a Texas joint puts some '90s hip-hop into its stacked-up specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Unique Eats
programme.desc: S33E9 - This trip, Guy Fieri is grabbing some unique eats. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Northern Southern
programme.desc: S33E12 - In Cambridge, Mass., a joint fries up Nashville hot chicken and gangster gumbo; a smoking spot in Sparks, Nev., firing up wagyu brisket and wing nachos; in Juneau, Alaska, a fusion house is putting out smoked-brisket pho and honey-bourbon ribs. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Hometown Inspiration
programme.desc: S35E7 - In Logan, Utah, a joint serving Louisiana specialties like blackened chicken pasta and a marrow butter burger; in Portland, Oregon, a place putting a vegan spin on Israeli flavors; in Denver, a pizza eatery all about Detroit-style pies. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Flavortown International
programme.desc: S36E5 - Flavors from all over the world; a Middle Eastern smorgasbord serving standout samosas and chicken kebab; funky spot turning out real-deal Mexican tortas; Indonesian specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Rib-Stickers
programme.desc: S38E7 - Guy finds clean eats in Sioux Falls, S.D., a 25-ingredient meatloaf in Fairbanks, Alaska, and Midwest mashups in Moorhead, Minn. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Domestic & Abroad
programme.desc: S40E11 - Guy Fieri's digging into all-American and foreign favorites; in Houston, a funky spot is firing up Filipino flavor with a twist; a real-deal Washington meat market is stacking up serious sandwiches. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sloppy, Spicy and Belly
programme.desc: S55E2 - Guy Fieri visits Sacramento, Calif., for pork tacos and a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla., restaurant for brisket sandwiches; in San Jose, Calif., a Cambodian restaurant serves pork belly noodles. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Funkalicious
programme.desc: S54E9 - Guy's getting funky with jerk chicken, duck confit banh mi, and more. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Grand Slam Sammy
programme.desc: S49E9 - Guy Fieri hits the road for serious sammies; a vegan joint in New Jersey plates plant-based perfection, TOC champ Tiffani Faison brings Southern barbecue to Boston and a family spot in California mixes it up with lights-out lamb. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwich Smorgasbord
programme.desc: S51E2 - Guy Fieri's having a sandwich extravaganza at a lunch spot in Indianapolis that is serving up serious flavors with the-bomb brisket au jus and rockin' roast pork. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Flavor World
programme.desc: S48E7 - Guy Fieri dives into a world of cultural cuisine with indigenous recipes; fry bread and pozole in Phoenix, Ariz.; authentic Argentine specialties in Boulder, Colo.; a kabob spot in Memphis, Tenn., marinates meats with Ethiopian flavor. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Cooking With Choi - Late Night Bites
programme.desc: S1E2 - Esther Choi shares some Korean street food classics, starting with extra crispy Korean Fried Chicken with Pickled Yuja Daikon; she also shows how to make Tteokbokki, chewy rice cakes simmered in a spicy sauce, and Gimmari, crispy seaweed rolls.

programme.title: Cooking With Choi - Korean Comfort Foods
programme.desc: S1E6 - Esther Choi shares some of her favorite Korean comfort foods; she makes a classic Korean rice roll, Kimbap, and takes it to the next level with a simple Ramyun; then, she pairs Seafood Japchae with Spinach Namul to keep things fresh and balanced.

programme.title: Cooking With Choi - Kimchi Time
programme.desc: S1E1 - Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi, a fast Mak Kimchi that's ready in just days, as well as Halmoni's Kimchi, her grandmother's recipe; plus, Esther shares how to make Kimchi Fried Rice and bossam, Korean Pork Belly Wraps.

programme.title: Cooking With Choi - Korean BBQ
programme.desc: S1E4 - Esther Choi makes some favorite Korean classics; first, she picks the perfect flanken-cut short ribs for her Korean barbecue dish of LA Kalbi with Ssamjang; Esther's hot pot dish, Bulgogi Mushroom Jeongol, is all about savory bulgogi flavor.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - For Pete's Sake
programme.desc: S12E8 - Cowboy Pete's had a long, hard summer working on the farm, so Ree Drummond is making a Tex-Mex dinner to thank him and his family; the menu includes carnitas, mango salad, a cheesy refried bean casserole, and guacamole with a kick.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Lunches to Go
programme.desc: S15E9 - Ree Drummond prepares three lunches; beef noodle salad bowls with peanut sauce; a cowboy bento box packed with chicken wings in homemade BBQ sauce, creamy lemon basil potato salad, and apple and celery slaw; kale pasta mason jar salad.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - How The Cookie Crumbles
programme.desc: S18E1 - Chocolate mint iced cookies decorated with swirls of snow-white royal icing; browned butter sugar cookies that become the base for cookie jam pies; next-level chocolate chip cookies with bacon and caramel corn; no bake cookies.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Faster Pasta
programme.desc: S22E6 - Ree shares her quick, delicious and crowd-pleasing pasta recipes; she makes lemon pasta, grilled steak pasta and drunken spaghetti with red wine.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Chilled out
programme.desc: S29E8 - Ree Drummond creates cool recipes for a very hot day; there's a salmon Nicoise Caesar salad mashup.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Fiesta Feast
programme.desc: S40E3 - Ree Drummond makes a fiesta feast with "Spicy Tex-Mex Chicken" for tacos, "Charro Style Beans" and "Loaded Guacamole"; she also makes frozen "Blueberry Peach Margaritas," a fruity spin on a favorite cocktail.

programme.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Dinner for Two

programme.title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini - Seafood Feast
programme.desc: S1E1 - Chef Gabe Bertaccini shows you the heart of real Italian cooking: simple, fresh ingredients and family recipes with a whole lot of love.

programme.title: The Kitchen - Last Call for Summer
programme.desc: S18E6 - The Kitchen savors one last bite of the flavors of the summer, starting with Katie Lee's French onion burger and Jeff Mauro's whole barbecued cauliflower; food writer Alison Roman bakes pistachio-plum crisp; Katie throws an ice cream party.

programme.title: The Kitchen - One Pan Plan
programme.desc: S38E13 - The Kitchen hosts are sharing their best one pan plans for easy meals, including Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Bowls and Pineapple Upside Down Cake. Plus, Scott Conant from House of Knives stops by to make his One Skillet Chicken with Basil Chimichurri.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Throwback Throwdown
programme.desc: S42E11 - Fieri welcomes the first three winners of GGG to return and compete for up to $20,000. First, the chefs must make a baller burger and side, even though all buns are out of stock. Then, the final two make a high-end dinner featuring only frozen foods.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Cooking the Books

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. - Courtney B. Vance, Keith David, Keesha Sharp, Rebecca Spence, Bentley Green (Crime drama)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Big City Greens - Fitness Test / The Farmies

programme.title: Big City Greens - Caging Cricket / Trainer Tilly

Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. programme.desc: Clarence is a spirited boy who sees the best in everything. His unique perspective on life transforms even a mundane situation into one that is interesting or fun. Epic dirt fights, awkward crushes and secret tree forts are all par for the course for the youngster, who shares his experiences with his family and friends. That group includes his best friends, scrappy Sumo and cautious Jeff, patient mom Mary, and her laid-back boyfriend, Chad. Clarence's adventures should be familiar to many people from their own childhoods, but he takes them to the limit. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination. - James Marsden, Jim Carrey, Tika Sumpter, Natasha Rothwell, Adam Pally (Family, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: While shopping at an outdoor market, young reporter Tintin (Jamie Bell), accompanied by his faithful dog, Snowy, buys a model of an old ship called the Unicorn. A shady character named Sakharine (Daniel Craig) and later an American named Barnaby (Joe Starr) try to buy the model from him, but Tintin refuses. The lad discovers that the ship contains a clue about a hidden treasure, but before he can locate it, Tintin is kidnapped and given over to the custody of drunken Capt. Haddock (Andy Serkis). (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence

programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees. - Billy Bob Thornton, Greg Kinnear, Marcia Gay Harden, Sammi Kane Kraft, Ridge Canipe (Comedy)

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back. - Juliette Binoche, Ralph Fiennes, Janet McTeer, Sophie Ward, Simon Shepherd (Drama)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "Sky Captain" (Jude Law) uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins (Gwyneth Paltrow), has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr. Totenkopf (Laurence Olivier), the mastermind behind the robots. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Angelina Jolie, Giovanni Ribisi, Michael Gambon (Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: Son of Rambow

programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Qualls, Fred Ward, Andy Dick (Comedy)

While Lisa is away, her older brother hides some drugs in the bathroom, which the family's pet owl ingests, causing it to behave erratically. Lisa comes home and starts to take a liking to Tom, but the situation is interrupted by an upset drug dealer and other mayhem. - Ashton Kutcher, Tara Reid, Jeffrey Tambor, Andy Richter, Michael Madsen (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Imagine That
programme.desc: Consumed by career woes and personal crises, a financial executive (Eddie Murphy) finds the answers to all his problems within his daughter's imaginary world.

programme.title: The Sandlot
programme.desc: When Scotty Smalls moves to a new neighborhood, he manages to make friends with a group of kids who play baseball at the sandlot.

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket (Phellipe Haagensen) is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood. José "Zé" Pequeno (Douglas Silva) is an ambitious drug dealer who uses Rocket and his photos as a way to increase his fame as a turf war erupts with his rival, "Knockout Ned" (Leandro Firmino da Hora). The film was shot on location in Rio's poorest neighborhoods. - Alexandre Rodrigues, Leandro Firmino da Hora, Phellipe Haagensen, Douglas Silva, Jonathan Haagensen (Crime drama, Drama)

programme.desc: Childhood friends Ace (Douglas Silva) and Wallace (Darlan Cunha) are both approaching their 18th birthdays. Ace struggles to raise his son alone after the mother takes a job in São Paulo, while Wallace embarks on a search for his long-missing father (Rodrigo dos Santos), whom he eventually finds having just finished serving 15 years in prison. Newly discovered secrets about the past will test Ace and Wallace's friendship as they find themselves on opposite sides of a gang war. - Douglas Silva, Darlan Cunha, Jonathan Haagensen, Rodrigo dos Santos, Eduardo BR (Drama, Crime drama)

This doesn't sit well with Rafe. With help from his new friend Leo (Thomas Barbusca), the mischievous lad concocts schemes to drive his tyrannical principal (Andy Daly) crazy while also using his charm and wits to impress a girl (Isabela Moner) and battle the bullies. - Griffin Gluck, Lauren Graham, Rob Riggle, Thomas Barbusca, Andy Daly (Children, Comedy, Animated)

Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

He's no role model, but his buddy Jimmy won't help him pay off his gambling debts unless Conor coaches Jimmy's corporately sponsored team. Surprising even himself, Conor becomes attached to his players -- and to their attractive schoolteacher (Diane Lane) -- and drawn into their tough and sometimes tragic lives. - Keanu Reeves, Diane Lane, John Hawkes, Bryan C. Hearne, Julian Griffith (Drama, Comedy)

programme.desc: Widower Cedric Brown hires Nanny McPhee to care for his seven rambunctious children, who have chased away all previous nannies. Taunted by Simon and his siblings, Nanny McPhee uses mystical powers to instill discipline. And when the children's great-aunt and benefactor, Lady Adelaide Stitch, threatens to separate the kids, the family pulls together under the guidance of Nanny McPhee. - Emma Thompson, Colin Firth, Kelly Macdonald, Derek Jacobi, Patrick Barlow (Children, Comedy)
